lanes.nightly_hosted: Real browser full portable-corpus seed+exact extraction. Chrome/Firefox run in e2e.yml. e2e-release.yml installs or enables Chromium, Edge, Brave, Opera, Opera GX, Vivaldi, Yandex, LibreWolf, Zen, and normal-profile Safari on supported hosted images.
lanes.release_fixture: Deterministic engine checks plus browser-id coverage in e2e-release.yml (tag, release, workflow_dispatch); no browser is launched.
lanes.manual: Operator-owned fallback for a registry cell without a viable hosted runner. No current cells rely on it.

depth_capabilities.registry_id: The canonical browser ID is exposed by the public registry.
depth_capabilities.browser_launch: A real browser process persists the seeded cookie store.
depth_capabilities.explicit_path: Supported explicit-path APIs decode the seeded store.
depth_capabilities.discovery: Registry-root discovery identifies the expected profile and source path.
depth_capabilities.recommended_read: The recommended read API selects and decodes the expected discovered profile.
depth_capabilities.crypto: A real platform credential path decrypts a browser-produced value.
depth_capabilities.exact_set: The complete decoded cookie set is compared with an independent manifest.
depth_capabilities.active_writer: Extraction reads the same store while its browser is still writing it.
depth_capabilities.locked_writer_safety: When a browser exclusively owns a rollback-journal store, every public surface refuses an unsafe read with a typed error and succeeds exactly after browser close.
depth_capabilities.partitioned: Browser-produced partition or container identity is asserted semantically.

depth_levels.none: The cell makes no claim for this capability.
depth_levels.fixture: The capability is asserted with a generated or captured fixture.
depth_levels.live: The capability is asserted against output produced by a launched browser in the same job.

top_frame_site_key.rationale: The partition-context workflow asserts two colliding CHIPS keys written by a live Chromium browser.

has_cross_site_ancestor.rationale: The live Chromium partition workflow asserts the cross-site ancestor bit on both CHIPS identities.

source_scheme.rationale: The live HTTPS Chromium context lane asserts a browser-produced source scheme for each partition.

source_port.rationale: The live HTTPS Chromium context lane compares every stored source port with its actual server port.

is_persistent.rationale: The live Chromium context lane asserts the browser-produced persistence bit. Firefox does not persist a corresponding field in cookies.sqlite, so its absence is not claimed as live field coverage.

origin_attributes.rationale: The Firefox dFPI lane asserts two complete browser-produced originAttributes strings and their parsed identities.

user_context_id.rationale: A disposable unsigned test extension creates a real Firefox Multi-Account Container and the workflow asserts its browser-produced userContextId exactly.

partition_key.rationale: The Firefox dFPI lane asserts two browser-produced partition keys and their send-time isolation.

private_browsing_id.rationale: Private browsing cookies are intentionally not written to the persistent cookie database.

fixture_limitations.linux/cachy: Deprecated browser with no maintained release channel.
fixture_limitations.macos/arc: The custom application startup has no stable unattended profile and DevTools contract for a hosted runner.
fixture_limitations.macos/coccoc: No maintained silent package-manager installer is available on the hosted image.
fixture_limitations.windows/arc: The packaged application is activated through MSIX rather than a flag-controllable browser executable.
fixture_limitations.windows/avast: No maintained silent package-manager installer is available on the hosted image.
fixture_limitations.windows/browser_from_vought: No maintained vendor or package-manager installer is available.
fixture_limitations.windows/coccoc: No maintained silent package-manager installer is available on the hosted image.
fixture_limitations.windows/dc_browser: No maintained vendor or package-manager installer is available.
fixture_limitations.windows/duckduckgo: The MSIX application owns an embedded WebView profile and exposes no custom-user-data browser CLI.
fixture_limitations.windows/internet_explorer: Current hosted images expose only Edge IE mode, which does not persist the legacy CookieEntryEx ESE format supported by this deprecated decoder.
fixture_limitations.windows/octo_browser: The commercial anti-detect browser requires operator-owned account and profile provisioning.
fixture_limitations.windows/qq_browser: No stable unattended vendor or package-manager installer is available to the runner.
